description: Production polish and finalization: a results screen with win/lose summary and rematch/return-to-menu flow, audio and visual feedback (procedural WebAudio SFX and simple background music toggle, screen-shake/hit flashes), responsive layout and a keybind/help panel, full localization audit so no untranslated strings remain, and a comprehensive README documenting the game, tech stack, i18n, how to run, and GitHub Pages deployment for the /game-champs/ subpath. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Create src/screens/Results.tsx: localized win/lose banner, match summary (champion played, outcome, simple stats like duration or damage), and buttons for Rematch (back to champion select or same matchup) and Main Menu. Style consistent with the League-inspired theme.

Add audio: src/game/audio.ts using the WebAudio API to generate lightweight procedural SFX (ability cast, hit, death, victory/defeat sting) so no binary asset files are required, plus a mute/volume toggle persisted to localStorage. Wire SFX triggers into BattleScene events. Optionally a subtle looped ambient tone toggle.
Add juice/feedback in BattleScene: camera shake on big hits, hit flashes on units, floating combat text easing, ability cast VFX polish - all via Phaser tweens/graphics.
Add a Settings/Help panel (React component) accessible from menu and battle: shows keybinds (localized), volume toggle, and language toggle. Ensure keybinds and all instructions are localized.

Responsive/layout pass: ensure the app and canvas scale sensibly on common desktop sizes and degrade gracefully on small screens (Phaser Scale.FIT or RESIZE), and the React chrome uses responsive CSS.

Localization audit: grep the src tree for hardcoded user-facing strings; move any stragglers into ko.json/en.json. Ensure the i18n key-parity test still passes and add any new keys to both locales with quality Korean copy.

Write game-champs/README.md: project overview (LoL-style champion-select + arena battle), tech stack (React+TS+Vite+Phaser, react-i18next), how the game plays and controls, champion roster summary, i18n (ko/en + toggle + how to add a locale), local dev (npm install/dev/build/preview/test), and GitHub Pages deployment (base '/game-champs/', the deploy.yml workflow, and note that the site serves at https://<owner>.github.io/game-champs/). Include a note that champion names/lore are original and not affiliated with Riot Games.
Final full verification: npm install, npm run build (confirm /game-champs/ base in dist output), npm run test -- --run, npx tsc --noEmit all green.
acceptance_criteria: Results screen shows localized outcome and offers Rematch and Main Menu, both routing correctly.
Procedural SFX play on gameplay events and a persisted mute/volume toggle works; no external audio binary files are required for the build to succeed.
A localized Settings/Help panel documents keybinds and exposes language + volume toggles.
No hardcoded user-facing strings remain in src/ (localization audit); i18n key-parity test passes for ko and en.
README documents gameplay, stack, i18n, run instructions, and GitHub Pages /game-champs/ deployment.
npm run build, npm run test -- --run, and npx tsc --noEmit all pass; dist/ references the /game-champs/ base path.
verification: cd game-champs && npm run build && grep -R "/game-champs/" dist/index.html
findings: All steps implemented and verified. Final state: npm run build OK (dist/index.html references /game-champs/ base), npm run test -- --run = 69 passed (65 prior + 4 new audio tests), npx tsc --noEmit clean. Work done: (1) Expanded src/screens/ResultScreen.tsx into a polished localized win/lose summary (eyebrow, animated banner, subtitle, accent-colored matchup, stat board). (2) New src/game/audio.ts: procedural WebAudio SFX (cast/ability/hit/death/victory/defeat/ui) + optional ambient drone, persisted mute/volume/ambient to localStorage, subscription API for React. Fully guarded against missing AudioContext (jsdom/SSR) so tests+build stay green; covered by new src/game/audio.test.ts. SFX wired into BattleScene events; audio.resume() called from user gestures (Play button, battle mount). (3) BattleScene juice: camera shake on big hits, white hit-flash + squash/stretch, death burst ring, ability cast flare (heavier for ultimates), stun star spin, eased/pop-in floating combat text, victory/defeat camera flash. (4) New src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx: localized Settings/Help modal reachable from header on every screen; documents localized keybinds, exposes mute/volume/ambient toggles + LanguageToggle. (5) Responsive CSS pass in global.css (header stacks, roster/stat grids collapse, HUD shrinks at <=720px and <=480px). (6) Localization audit: grep found no hardcoded user-facing strings; added settings.* and result.{vs,winSubtitle,loseSubtitle} keys to BOTH ko.json and en.json with natural Korean; i18n parity test passes. (7) Comprehensive README.md at repo root (overview, tech stack, gameplay+controls, roster table, i18n + how to add a locale, local dev, GitHub Pages /game-champs/ deployment with savagemanage.github.io URL, structure, Riot non-affiliation note). KNOWN ISSUE FIXED: added matchNonce counter in App.handleRematch/handleLockIn, threaded through BattleScreen -> PhaserGame and added to the effect deps so an identical-champion rematch forces a fresh Phaser scene. Note: Phaser bundles into a ~1.5MB code-split chunk (dynamic import) which triggers Vite's 500kB chunk-size warning; this is expected and non-fatal. NOT committed per orchestrator instructions.
